title: Swaying Pines | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled along the pristine shores of Western Lake, this breathtaking vacation home offers an unparalleled blend of luxury and natural beauty. With its stunning panoramic views, each level of the three-story residence has been meticulously designed to provide an atmosphere of upscale comfort and tranquility. The heart of the home on the first floor features a seamless flow between the living room and kitchen, highlighting exquisite details like reclaimed farm wood beams, cypress shiplap walls, and Chicago reclaimed brick. Ideal for entertaining or quiet family dinners, the space includes a large dining table for eight and a central island with bar stool seating for five. A screened-in porch extends the living area outdoors, equipped with a fireplace, outdoor kitchen, and a flat-screen TV, creating a cozy retreat for evenings under the stars. The elegance continues on the second floor, where each of the four guest bedrooms features a king-sized bed and private bathroom, including two opulent master suites. One suite offers a serene escape with vaulted ceilings and a sitting nook facing the park and lake, complemented by a luxurious bathroom with a walk-in shower and soaking tub. The third floor serves as a leisure hub with a lounge area, wet bar, and comfortable seating, perfect for family gatherings. Younger guests or families will appreciate the thoughtfully designed bedrooms with built-in bunk beds and a separate twin bunk room. Completing the experience is a theater room with a projector TV, making every night a special movie night. This home not only promises a memorable stay but invites you into a lifestyle of sophisticated relaxation and scenic splendor.
